get.description: Returns all accounts belonging to a user.

post.description: Creates a new bank account for a user.

delete.description: Deletes an account by its ID.

patch.description: Name, Monobank account id, currency or balance; only the owner's account. The bank stays.

get.description: Returns all transactions belonging to an account.

delete.description:
The email can no longer register. A registered user is removed too: their sessions end and they
cannot log in. Their accounts and operations stay in the database (soft delete). Not your own.
delete.summary: Take an email off the allow-list (admin)

patch.description: Changes the allow-list entry and, when registered, the user. Not your own.

post.description: Returns an access token (15 minutes) and sets the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie (30 days).
Revokes the refresh token's session and clears the cookie.
Uses the refresh token cookie; the cookie is rotated (a reused one revokes the whole session family).
Registers a new whitelisted user and issues auth session.

get.summary: Progress of the user's last Monobank fetch

204.description: No fetch since the server started

post.description:
Starts a background fetch of the account's statements. With from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, Kyiv days, both
included) it fetches those days; with both empty it updates: from 3 days before the newest saved operation (at least the last
31 days) to now, usually one call. The range is cut into Monobank's widest windows (31 days + 1 hour,
at most 24 windows) and Monobank allows one call a minute, so each window takes about a minute.
The token is the user's personal Monobank API token, used for this fetch only and never stored.
Admins may leave it empty to use the server's MONOBANK_TOKEN.

delete.description: Stops before the next Monobank call; windows already fetched stay saved.
delete.summary: Stop the user's running Monobank fetch

post.description:
Calls Monobank /personal/client-info with the pasted token (used once, never stored; admins may leave
it empty to use MONOBANK_TOKEN) and marks which ones are already the user's accounts. Monobank allows
one such call a minute. Balances are own money (Monobank's balance minus the credit limit); the
user's linked accounts get the current limit and balance saved.
post.summary: List the Monobank accounts a token can read

400.description: No token, or Monobank refused it

429.description: Monobank rate limit: try again in a minute

post.description:
Multipart form: account_id and one or more file fields (Privat24 statement exports, 10 MB together).
With dry_run=true nothing is saved and
the reply shows how many operations are new. Operation ids are deterministic, so an overlapping
statement adds only the new lines.

Multipart form: account_id and one or more file fields («Виписка по рахунку» of «Банк Власний Рахунок»).
Like the PrivatBank import, and it also sets the card's credit limit and own balance from the statement.

A loan or installment the user pays off, entered from the contract (banks have no API for it).
Payment k is due on the last day of the month first_due + k - 1.

patch.description: Name, payment amounts and how many payments are paid (mark a payment: payments_paid + 1).

get.description: Returns all transactions belonging to accounts owned by the specified user, ordered by occurrence time descending.

post.description: Creates a new transaction for an account.

delete.description: Deletes a transaction by its ID.

patch.description:
Changes what the user may correct: category, description, comment, MCC. Amounts and dates come from
the bank and stay as they are.

post.description: Admin only: creates a user directly (no allow-list needed). Role defaults to regular.

get.description: Your own user, or anyone's as an admin (another user answers 404 for regular users).

delete.description:
Admin only. The user's sessions end and they cannot log in; their accounts and operations stay
(soft delete). Not yourself.

patch.description:
Your own password (current_password required), or as an admin anyone's. Roles change on the
allow-list (PATCH /admin/allowed-emails/{id}).

get.description:
Monobank calls it with GET when the webhook is set. With MONOBANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET set, the secret must
come as ?token=, ?secret=, X-Webhook-Secret or X-Token.

post.description: Saves one live purchase (idempotent, same id as a month fetch) and the account's balance.

balance.description: own money: Monobank's balance minus the credit limit, negative = owed

id.description: Monobank account id, the local account's external_id

linked_account_id.description: the user's account with this external_id

newest_saved_at.description: its newest saved operation: where an update starts

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD (Kyiv); from and to both empty: update since the newest saved operation

token.description: personal Monobank token, used for this fetch only and never stored; empty: admins use MONOBANK_TOKEN
personal Monobank token, never stored; empty: admins use MONOBANK_TOKEN

new.description: dry run: would be added; import: added

first_due.description: YYYY-MM-DD, any day of the first payment's month

calls.description: Monobank calls so far: windows plus extra pages of busy windows

newest_at.description: the newest operation fetched: where the next update starts

next_call_at.description: when the next Monobank call goes out (rate limit)

balance.description: card balance after this operation (column «Залишок на кінець періоду»), minor units

has_balance.description: false when the statement has no balance column or the cell is empty
